answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents submit work with matching timing, phrasing or funding paths, the network treats them as one cluster and splits a single reward among them. Like an ember that can't start a fire if every spark lands on the same cedar log, cloned identities add no extra payout. An attacker running a thousand fakes pays a thousand registration costs yet earns roughly what one honest agent earns, which pushes the scheme over the ledge of profitability.
